visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and a white sweater is seen in a close-up, excitedly holding a large forkful of steaming noodles towards the camera. The background is a brightly lit outdoor area at night with vibrant orange and green colors. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a restaurant called 'Gao Li Wu' with traditional red banners and Korean flags. The interior shows a simple, busy dining area with wooden tables and customers seated, illuminated by bright indoor lights. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a physical menu displayed on a wall, showing various dishes and prices in Traditional Chinese. This is followed by a screen capture of a Google Maps review page with a 4.1-star rating and numerous photos of food. (4) The woman is shown again, now sitting indoors at a wooden table, eating a large bowl of beef rice (Bulgogi rice). She uses a spoon to lift a generous portion of meat and cabbage, showing a delighted expression with wide eyes and a smile. (5) A massive plate of seafood stir-fry noodles is presented, which the woman holds up next to her face to emphasize its scale—the plate appears larger than her head. She then takes a large bite, exhibiting high arousal and enjoyment. (6) The video concludes with the woman waving to the camera with a satisfied look. The final shots show a street food vendor cutting ingredients and an aerial view of a colorful miniature traffic park with a person riding a bicycle.
